name: think
description: Deep strategic thinking mode that finds the single highest-leverage, most innovative action by blending concepts across domains. Use this skill whenever the user asks you to think, brainstorm, strategize, or figure out what to do next — even casually. Trigger on phrases like "what should we do", "what's the best approach", "what would you suggest", "think about this", "what's the smartest move", "I'm stuck", "ideas?", "hmm what if we...", "what's next", "how should we approach", or any request for creative/strategic ideation rather than straightforward execution. When in doubt about whether the user wants execution or ideation, lean toward triggering this skill.
